svg.text: the mitten first, the knuckle arc second, the fingers last — one hand five ways
1 · the mitten — a palm is a rounded box
3 · the skeleton — three hinges per finger
rounded box + thumb wedge — no fingers yet
four bases on an arc — middle highest, pinky lowest
only now: flesh, wrinkles, the three creases
V · the grip — holding the pen that draws it
side view: fingers wrap, thumb opposes — never parallels
the rule of thumb, so to speak: fingers ≈ palm long · middle longest · thumb opposes
